set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Checked tabulate rejects invalid codes and any masking constructor is explicitly named tabulateMasked.
- wordCount is private or validates every public argument.
- fromWords consumes at most expected plus one iterator values.
- Any portable byte representation specifies byte order, word order, bit order, versioning, and tail-bit rules.
- union, intersection, xor, and difference use specialized monomorphic word loops when benchmarks justify them.
- Tests cover 1-, 2-, and 4-bit codes, views, tail bits, invalid lengths, serialization round trips, and platform parity.
set.title: Harden packed constructors, serialization, and wordwise kernels
